# UAV Flight Logs

Directory: `C:\Sovereign\AE-Hub\data\uav\`

## Purpose
Stores UAV telemetry, mission plans, fleet status snapshots, and flight telemetry ingested from the field.

## Subdirectories
- `telemetry/` — Per-flight telemetry JSON streams
- `missions/` — Approved mission plans with waypoints
- `fleet/` — Fleet registry snapshots and status reports

## Generated by
- `modules/uav_fleet.py`

## Retention
90 days per governance.json
